schema_target: product (db/002-taste-cohorts-and-facets.sql), slot claims via product_slot -> slot_kind(code), facets via product_facet -> facet
notes: NOT A SEED FILE. Nothing here has been written to any database.
facet_slugs use the 'dimension:code' form that scripts/seed-fixtures.mjs uses; every one was checked against a facet seeded in db/002, db/012, db/016 or db/026.
destination_affinity, era_tags and facet_slugs are EDITORIAL JUDGEMENT on every row, including rows marked 'sourced'. 'sourced' refers to the name/price/URL/supplier only.
Casa de Perrin prices are RENTAL rates per piece per event, not purchase prices. price_band is computed from them anyway and will read far too cheap against a purchase catalogue.
Chairish rows are single one-of-a-kind listings and will 404 when they sell.
image_url values are REFERENCES to supplier-hosted images. No image was downloaded or copied. Displaying them on a Revelle surface is an unresolved licensing question.
price_band_rule: cents < 2500 under_25; < 7500 from_25_to_75; < 20000 from_75_to_200; < 50000 from_200_to_500; else over_500. Upper bounds treated as exclusive.
